research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Twelve Labs is researching and developing video retrieval methods and apparatuses, such as a video retrieval method using post processing on segmented videos and a method for providing a user interface for video retrieval. Their work includes adaptive thresholding for videos using artificial intelligence and machine-learned multi-modal artificial intelligence models for video analysis, focusing on efficient query handling and video data processing. These areas collectively address video foundation model accessibility and multimodal AI for video products.

overview_description.description: TwelveLabs develops artificial intelligence models and infrastructure for understanding, searching, and analyzing video content. Its platform enables applications to interpret visual, audio, and spoken information within videos, allowing users to perform semantic search, generate summaries, identify events and objects, and extract insights from video data. The company provides APIs and multimodal AI models that support use cases across media, entertainment, security, enterprise knowledge management, and other video-intensive applications. It also conducts research in video understanding and machine learning to improve how AI processes and reasons over video content.

about_short_description.short_description: TwelveLabs develops artificial intelligence models and infrastructure for understanding, searching, and analyzing video content.

product.name: Video Search API
product.description: An AI-driven video search tool that enables natural language queries to find specific scenes by analyzing speech, text, audio, and visuals within videos.

product.name: Video Classification API
product.description: A customizable video classification system that categorizes videos into hierarchical classes based on semantic content without requiring model retraining.

product.name: Video Clustering
product.description: A method to group videos by content similarity using video embeddings without labeled data, facilitating organization and personalized recommendations.

product.name: Video-Language Modeling
product.description: Multimodal AI models that integrate video and language data to generate text-based summaries, descriptions, and responses related to video content.

product.name: Analyze API (formerly Generate API)
product.description: An API that generates concise textual representations of videos, including titles, summaries, chapters, and highlights, using multimodal AI analysis.

product.name: Rodeo
product.description: AI-powered creative copilot that lets creators search, edit, and assemble video footage using natural language.
